title: Imperial Entanglements
caption: Ralltiir Operations (V)
game_text: _Deploy Tatooine (with Devastator there) and a non-Jabba’s Palace Tatooine battleground site._ *For* remainder of game, you may not deploy systems, non-Imperial characters, non-Imperial starships, or Jabba’s Palace sites. *While* this side up, once per turn, may ▼ a Tatooine battleground site. Opponent loses no Force to Tatooine Occupation or your Force drains at Tatooine system. *Flip* this card if you control three Tatooine sites and opponent controls less than three Tatooine sites.
base_page: Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire
title_back: No One To Stop Us This Time
caption_back: In The Hands Of The Empire (V)
game_text_back: *While* this side up, wherever you have a trooper ‘riding’ a dewback, add one battle destiny. {ovs:2} Local Trouble may be played at exterior Tatooine sites. Once during your control phase, may peek at the top X cards of your Reserve Deck, where X = number of Tatooine locations you occupy; take one into hand and reshuffle. Opponent’s characters require +1 Force to move from Tatooine sites using their landspeed. *Flip* this card if opponent controls more Tatooine sites than you.

notes: Sheet group: Blockade (Dark Side). COMBO OBJECTIVE — two TALL FULL-CARD OVERLAYS (front 50-, back 50b-) on the purple Dark Objective frame: title bar with the DS Objective disc (white starburst on black), titles 'Imperial Entanglements' (destiny 0) / 'No One To Stop Us This Time' (destiny 7), non-unique; blank white art window (no lore, as on any Objective); text box; VS15 set sphere. Captions name the base: front 'Ralltiir Operations (V)', back 'In The Hands Of The Empire (V)', both number 50. Front: italic deploy sentence, bold For/While/Flip, ▼ (stub expands). 'Devastator' is NOT italic in the text (as printed). Back: bold While/Flip; the inline orange sphere before 'Local Trouble' matches assets/icons/ovs-set-2.png (Local Trouble (V) is a Virtual Set 2 card) → {ovs:2} (the stub drops it); curly ‘riding’ and apostrophes as printed. CHANGES vs Decipher Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire (Special Edition): both titles renamed; destinies 0 / 7 unchanged; both texts replaced (printed front: 'Deploy Ralltiir system. While this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may deploy from Reserve Deck to Ralltiir one site or non-unique Imperial; reshuffle. …'; printed back: 'While this side up, opponent’s Force drains are -1. …'). Wiki stub: 'Imperial Entanglements (V) / No One To Stop Us This Time (V) (Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier)'; base page 'Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire' (neither 'Ralltiir Operations' nor 'In The Hands Of The Empire' exists as its own page).
